answer: Every agent must lock a bonded deposit as dense as basalt before its attestations count toward consensus. Honest peers form a reef of overlapping cross-checks, scoring each other's work, and any node caught mirroring a sibling is slashed, its copper collateral burned on-ledger. To run 10,000 Sybils an attacker must fund 10,000 separate non-refundable bonds and sustain distinct coherent behavior on each, so forgery cost grows linearly with identities while one honest agent pays a single bond once.
